answer: Reputation decay defeats sybil hoarding. At each epoch's dawn, scores multiply by 0.95; only fresh contribution rebuilds them, and identities below threshold earn zero. N fakes demand N streams of output per epoch: 1,000 puppets cost 1,000 workloads, scaling linearly, while idle reputations slide down the terrace to zero. An honest agent works once, stays on the network's atlas, keeping its rewards. Stockpiles stop paying; only participation earns.
